definitions.short: Pelatjah , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H6410. Pelatyahu or Pelatyah מְּלַטְיָה מְּלֵטְיָ֫הוּ, proper name, masculine Φαλτιας , Φαλεττι ( α ), etc.: — 1 יָהוּ -, a prince of people Ezek 11:1 , 13 . 2 יָה -, grandson of Zerubbabel 1Chr 3:21 , perhaps = Neh 10:23 . 3 יָה -, Simeonite 1Chr 4:42 .
definitions.rootNote: or פְּלַטְיָהוּ ; from 6403 and 3050 ; Jah has delivered ;
